2025-01-16.title: Reliance Profit Beats on Consumer Businesses, Resilient Oil
2025-01-16.description: Reliance Industries Ltd., controlled by billionaire Mukesh Ambani, posted a slightly better-than-expected quarterly profit, as gains from its telecom and retail units offset the volatility in its petrochemical business.

2026-04-26.title: Ambani flags ‘unprecedented dislocation’ as Reliance net slips
2026-04-26.description: Billionaire Mukesh Ambani flagged the “unprecedented dislocation” unleashed by the US-Iran war after Reliance Industries Ltd.’s quarterly profit slipped but managed to meet analyst expectations due to a strong show by its consumer units.
